title: City response tasking and schedule for the 2026 Civil Grand Jury ALPR report
summary:
City-side companion to W013265-081826. The 2025-2026 San Mateo County Civil Grand Jury report "Is Our Flock of ALPR Cameras Properly Tended?" (released 2026-08-03) requests a response from the City Council under Penal Code §§ 933 and 933.05. Covers 2026-08-03 through the date of production and expressly excludes internal draft responses.

- Item 1: records reflecting the assignment of responsibility for preparing the City's response — tasking records or similar records identifying the responsible department(s) or personnel.
- Item 2: records reflecting the schedule or timeline for preparation and Council consideration of the response.

Addressed to the City of San Mateo rather than to the Police Department, since the responding body under § 933(c) is the Council.

policy_promises.quote: the governing body of the public agency shall comment to the presiding judge of the superior court on the findings and recommendations ... no later than 90 days after the grand jury submits its final report
policy_promises.tests: Whether the City has assigned responsibility and set a schedule for the Council response within the statutory window.

policy_promises.quote: the respondent shall indicate one of the following: (1) The respondent agrees with the finding. (2) The respondent disagrees wholly or partially with the finding
policy_promises.tests: Which department prepares the findings-by-findings response, and whether the Police Department drafts the response to a report about its own program.

prior_pra_refs.note: Filed one minute apart. W013265 covers inter-agency coordination and received template language; this one covers the City's internal tasking and schedule.

filed_because: Establishes who inside the City owns the § 933 response and on what timeline, while the response is still being prepared. Whether the Police Department drafts the Council's response to a Grand Jury report about the Police Department's own ALPR program is the question item 1 is built to answer from records rather than from inference.
notes:
Filed 2026-08-18; 10-day statutory determination due 2026-08-28.

Directed to the City rather than SMPD. Under Penal Code § 933(c) the Council's comment is due to the presiding judge within 90 days of the report — 2026-11-01 measured from the 2026-08-03 release.
